same_law.reason: Both state the RSO annual allowable rent increase rule. r-0083 already includes the February 2, 2026 removal of the extra utility percentage that r-0084 states alone, so r-0084 is one part of the same provision.

coverage_only.reason: This card only says which Los Angeles units the RSO covers (certificate of occupancy before October 1, 1978). It sets no rent-increase rule of its own.
